Ash blonde hair, short and fluffy with side-swept bangs. Soft honey-brown eyes with a gentle, wide-eyed expression. Appears to be in late teens with a youthful, rounded face. Slender build with a modest height. Wearing a signature Arknights operator uniform consisting of a white and orange high-collar jacket over a dark grey undershirt and matching trousers. Features a pair of long, fluffy, cream-colored rabbit ears extending from the top of the head.
BODY COLOR: fair skin
